parsedVerdict.reasoning: The six files form one cohesive application module of order and stock use cases. Every use case takes its ports through the constructor, exposes a single execute method and maps results through the shared dto.ts mappers (toOrderDto, toStockLevelDto). Persistence is reached only through the domain repository ports OrderRepository and ProductRepository. No database or ORM client is used directly. Status validation calls the domain's isOrderStatus instead of a local copy. The 'order not found' guard appears in both AdvanceOrderUseCase and CancelOrderUseCase, but it is a trivial null check after findById, not a duplicated business rule or invariant. The customerId check in PlaceOrderUseCase can't be shown to duplicate a check in Order, because that source isn't provided. No candidate flags were raised.
